description: Claude Code's additional hook file: PreCompact, which zCode does not document and therefore cannot live in the shared hooks/hooks.json that both hosts auto-discover. Claude Code loads this file because the manifest's hooks field names it as an addition to the auto-discovered standard file.

hooks.command: P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT}}/skills/ultragoal/scripts/goal_pre_compact.py"; [ -f "$P" ] || exit 0; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$P"; else exec python "$P"; fi
hooks.commandWindows: (if not exist "%CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT%\skills\ultra-goal\scripts\goal_pre_compact.py" exit 0) & where py >nul 2>nul || exit 0 & py -3 "%CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT%\skills\ultra-goal\scripts\goal_pre_compact.py"
